title: Deliver Gold to Daningstone-on-sea Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Gold** delivered to **Daningstone-on-sea Bank** (industry id 9, near tile 58,95).

A likely supplier is **Daningstone-on-sea Gold Mine** (industry id 8, near tile 83,107); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
